summary:
Senior Full Stack Software Developer with 9+ years of experience building enterprise web platforms with Java/Spring Boot on the backend and Angular/React/Next.js on the frontend. Delivers scalable, maintainable systems in fintech and high-traffic domains with strong ownership from architecture to production operations. Actively uses modern AI-assisted engineering workflows for code generation, refactoring, test acceleration, and developer productivity.

Core Focus Areas:
- Full Stack Engineering: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Angular, React.js, Next.js, TypeScript
- Backend Architecture: REST APIs, GraphQL, Microservices, Event-Driven Systems, Redis/Kafka integration
- Frontend Engineering: Angular and React component architecture, state management, performance optimization
- Quality and Delivery: Playwright, Jest, Cypress, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud-native deployments
- Leadership: Mentoring engineers, improving standards, and reducing delivery risk in cross-functional teams
